params.body:
Removes duplicates. Behaviour stays the same.

- **Redirect for old cohort links.** Trends and Posts each moved `?generation=gen-teens` to its lifestage, with their own code (`movedCohort` in TrendController and an inline copy in ArticleController). Both now call `Taxonomy::movedCohortQuery`, still with a 301.
- **Tags that have content.** `sectorsWithContent`, `generationsWithContent` and `lifestagesWithContent` ran the same query on different columns. They now share `publishedTags($column)`.
- In TrendController, the "showcase set" comment was above the redirect. It is back above the code it describes.

Checks: Pint passes; PHPUnit runs 317 tests with 0 failures (CohortAxesTest covers both redirects).
params.title: One redirect for old cohort links, one query for tags in use
